title: Retry one_bed_apartment Infinigen import with lower memory path
objective: Retry setting up /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment in SpearSim after the first Unreal import was killed with exit 137/OOM while building static meshes. Run the retry in tmux so the user can attach and monitor.
instructions: Do not edit product code and do not perform Git operations.
Create or reuse a detached tmux session named spear_one_bed_apartment_import_retry for the retry, leaving it open at the end for inspection.
Use the documented Infinigen-to-SPEAR flow from docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md and the existing setup script examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py.

Input scene is /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment/coarse/scene.blend. Target map path is /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Maps/one_bed_apartment and mesh dir is /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Meshes.

Because the previous import failed with exit 137/OOM during static mesh build, retry with a lighter FBX export: prefer resolution 512, and if import still fails from memory pressure, retry once at 256. Use a distinct export output dir per resolution under /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs so logs/artifacts remain inspectable.
Run import with --replace-existing-assets and --replace-existing-map so partial assets from the failed attempt are replaced.
If import succeeds, run the cook/package/archive step for the target map. If any step fails, keep tmux open and report the failing command, exit status, and likely cause.
Verify tmux session is running after dispatch and include the attach command plus any suggested final run command in the ResultPacket.
constraints: No commits, no pushes, no PRs.
Do not ask the user to run the commands; run them in tmux.
expected_outputs: Detached tmux retry session with export/import/cook commands dispatched.
Clear ResultPacket stating whether the workflow is running, completed, or failed to start, with attach command and target map path.
definition_of_done: tmux session spear_one_bed_apartment_import_retry exists and is either actively running the retry workflow or has completed with visible final status.
ResultPacket summarizes the retry configuration and next command to run the map after success.
